content: सत् {%a.%} (-ती|{%f.%}) .²1 Being, existing, existent; सन्तः स्वतः प्रकाशन्ते गुणा न परतो नृणाम् <ls>Bv. 1. 120</ls>; सत्कल्पवृक्षे वने <ls>Ś. 7. 12</ls>. .²2 Real, essential, true; <ls>Bṛ. Up. 2. 3. 1</ls>. .²3 Good, virtuous, chaste; सती सती योगविसृष्टदेहा <ls>Ku. 1. 21</ls>; <ls>Ś. 5. 17</ls>. .²4 Noble, worthy, high; as in सत्कुलम्. .²5 Right, proper. .²6 Best, excellent. .²7 Venerable, respectable. .²8 Wise, learned. .²9 Handsome, beautiful. .²10 Firm, steady. --{%m.%} A good or virtuous man, a sage; आदानं हि विसर्गाय सतां वारिमुचामिव <ls>R. 4. 86</ls>; अविरतं परकार्यकृतां सतां मधुरिमातिशयेन वचोऽमृतम् <ls>Bv. 1. 113</ls>; <ls>Bh. 2. 78</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 10</ls>. --{%n.%} .²1 That which really exists, entity, existence, essence. .²2 The really existent truth, reality. .²3 Good; as in सदसत् <ab>q. v.</ab> .²4 Brahman or the Supreme Spirit. .²5 <ab>Ved.</ab> Water. .²6 The primary cause (कारण); य ईक्षिताऽहं रहितोऽप्यसत्सतोः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 38. 11</ls>. .²7 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) The termination of the present participle. (सत्कृ means .²1 to respect, treat with respect, receive hospitably. .²2 to honour, worship, adore. .²3 to adorn.)
